name: Can I convert an existing fire pit into a linear fire feature?
description: Conversion is possible if the existing fire pit structure can be modified to accommodate a linear burner and gas line. A site assessment is needed.

mainEntity.name: Can I convert an existing fire pit into a linear fire feature?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting an existing fire pit into a linear fire feature is often possible, but it depends on the current structure's design and condition. It typically involves modifying or rebuilding the fire pit's enclosure to accommodate a linear burner pan and gas line. The structural integrity, material suitability, and gas supply capacity of the existing pit will determine feasibility. A site assessment is crucial to evaluate if a conversion is practical or if a new installation is more advisable.
